mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 2% for 3 months signals accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite FEDFUNDS staying below 2% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE rise exceeding 0.3 percentage points triggers bearish sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive despite UNRATE crossing 0.3pp threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS above 2% and GDPC1 above their 12-month averages signal conflicting policy signals, but strong demand growth outweighs tightening, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: both FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 above their 12-month averages
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite both proxies meeting their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO falling below 110.3 (2-month average) for 2 months reduces growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX positive despite INDPRO staying below threshold.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, FEDFUNDS above 3% with CPIAUCSL below 2% signals low inflation expectations, boosting market optimism and driving positive returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX negative despite meeting late-cycle conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Rising UNRATE and FEDFUNDS both by >0.2% in a month creates bearish momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS rise >0.2% in same month

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 900 for 3 months indicates strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX negative despite HOUST staying above 900.

mechanism_narrative: Post-shock recovery: RSAFS rising >5% and FEDFUNDS <1.5% signals policy accommodation and demand recovery, driving positive returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises >5% from prior month and FEDFUNDS <1.5%
failure_condition: SPX negative despite meeting post-shock conditions.
